observed.caption: Hazy distant view of a city skyline with high-rise buildings rising above dense trees and mountains on the horizon.
observed.description: A wide, elevated view looks across a sprawling urban area under a pale, hazy sky. In the foreground a dense canopy of green trees fills the lower portion of the image. Several mid- and high-rise buildings emerge from the trees, including a blue-glass building on the right with a low wavy-roof structure in front of it, a dark blocky building complex in the center, and a lighter high-rise on the left. Beyond the central buildings a low-density urban area stretches toward a large, muted mountain range that spans the horizon. The atmosphere is hazy, softening distant details and giving the sky and background a washed-out appearance.
